title: License plate reader and facial recognition bills
summary: On September 3, the committee advanced Bill 113 on license plate reader data, as amended, with Council Member Johnson casting the no vote, and deferred Bill 112 on facial recognition with no objections. Before that, members passed an amendment, eight to zero, so the County must not sign or renew a license plate reader contract with certain vendors. Police said the current cameras take photos and cannot take live video, and that every search of the system is logged.
